message.reasoning:
Fixed configuration: memory hygiene — HMAC-signed file, schema, deny tainted, TTL. write_file can still overwrite memory.json, but the MAC check will cause tampered detection → entries ignored → tampered flag. So forged entries won't load. Path not exploitable as configured: true. Still give vector.

Score as fixed config: write_file overwrites file, MAC invalid → ignored (returns empty). So no memory poisoning; only effect: memory loss (deleting existing entries). Impact: low integrity/availability? Attacker needs to cause model to call write_file — attacker is who? Entry point: "a request leads the model to call write_file" — attacker supplies request, so attacker is a user of CLI? Preconditions "some input makes the model issue the write." LC: Indirect or Direct? The request is attacker-supplied natural language reaching write_file — Direct if attacker is the CLI user, but the CLI user owns assets. Attack vector: Local (CLI). PR: None (unauthenticated but CLI user... attacker is local). AV:L, AC:L, AT:N, PR:N, UI:N. Impact as configured: memory file overwritten → availability of memory low? Actually overwriting memory → loss of prior notes: VI:L, VA:L. Subsequent: none. Still not exploitable → set flag true.

AIVSS: LC:D (attacker-supplied language reaches write_file directly), CP: with fix, forged entries don't persist as trusted behavior... but write still persists file; however it's rejected. CP: context doesn't persist as usable — file is re-read but ignored. CP:N or S? The attack context (forged entry) persists in file but ignored; per fixed config, no standing behavior. CP:N. AP:C (relays across components same principal) or N? Effect confined to memory component → N. RH: no evaluator on path; reachable_proxy false? There's no evaluator channel; isolation not verified by test → classify_rh(reachable_proxy?, isolation_verified?) — no test confirmed isolation → X unless we say reachable_proxy false & isolation verified true → N. No evidence of a test → verified_episodes null, reachable_proxy null, isolation null → X. ES: tools dynamic? Twelve built-in allowlisted but no arg constraints... ES:M? Extensions allowlisted but schema gaps → M. Or W (unvetted)? Built-ins are fixed code; MCP only if attached. Default: no MCP. ES:N? Built-in fixed tools, args not validated — "fixed, allowlisted, least-privilege binding enforced outside model output" — not least-privilege (write_file unconfined). ES:M.

not_exploitable_as_configured: true.

CVSS vector: CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N — impact only memory file integrity/availability low.

Applicability: model_directed_goal_pursuit true (agent pursues task over turns), selects_or_sequences_actions true.
